bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH TUESDAY EVENING... Combined seas 10 to 13 ft. Bar conditions rough. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 345 AM Tuesday and 400 PM Tuesday. The Tuesday afternoon ebb will be very strong.
bar.ebb: afternoon ebb will be very strong
